explanation.text:
MOWI ASA (org.nr 964 118 191) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 1992-05-18, registered 1995-02-20. Business address: Sandviksbodene 77A/B, 5035 BERGEN. Main industry (NACE): 03.211 Produksjon av fisk, bløtdyr, krepsdyr og pigghuder i sjø og brakkvann. Registered employees: 2,644 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue EUR 1,887,000,000; operating result EUR 242,000,000; net result EUR 64,000,000; total assets EUR 7,081,000,000; equity EUR 2,856,000,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue EUR 6,146,000,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Ivan Vindheim; board chair Leif Teksum; 7 other board members. Sub-units registered: 93. Website: www.mowi.com. The website describes the company as: "Mowi supplies sustainable seafood to over 70 countries, providing 9.7 million meals daily. Explore our products, investor relations, and global careers." LEI: 549300W1OGQF5LZIH349 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mowi.

- wikidata: item carries P2333 = org number
